title: Actual RibaMod t=24 accepted-memory versus current-forcing allocation bridge
purpose: Bridge the qualified DUMMY-20H6 exact-release t=24 allocation oracle back into the actual pinned RibaMod+MF6+Ribasim product route, without changing the accepted-state, current-forcing or allocation references.
hypotheses: The first four 6-hour accepted states reproduce the qualified DUMMY-20H active-River day-1 prefix, including t=24 Basin level 1.000007990372381 m within tolerance.

The fifth RibaMod product step uses the newly accepted t=24 Ribasim stage to compute and publish an active-River forcing consistent with the frozen DUMMY-20H6 8.0000425122 m3/day reference within the existing 0.01 m3/day forcing tolerance.
The actual Ribasim allocation output contains a new fixed-grid t=24 record after the fifth product update.
The t=24 actual-product root allocation is 39.9903723811 m3/day within 0.05 m3/day and external allocation is zero.
The increase from the t=0 32 m3/day root allocation to the t=24 allocation equals the accepted day-1 storage excess of 7.9903723811 m3 within 0.05 m3/day.
The t=24 actual-product allocation therefore matches the DUMMY-20H6 free-alpha oracle rather than the invalidated old same-boundary forcing-subtraction premise.
External physical supply remains zero through the first post-boundary 6-hour segment and the coupled source/infiltration/UserDemand/storage ledger closes.
falsification_signatures: t=24 allocation remains 32/0 despite reproduction of the accepted day-1 state
t=24 allocation is approximately 31.99033/0 or otherwise directly subtracts current River forcing from accepted-memory budget
no t=24 allocation record is produced when the actual product crosses that fixed allocation boundary
the actual day-1 accepted state or next-step River forcing does not reproduce its qualified authority within tolerance

observability.allocation_authority: Read actual Ribasim results/allocation.nc after finalization; require distinct t=0 and t=24 allocation records.
observability.physical_authority: Read XMI Basin level, cumulative UserDemand inflow, cumulative infiltration and MF6 River flux at accepted 6-hour boundaries.

forbidden: no retuning from H7 observed output
no modification of H6 numerical references or tolerances
no substitution of physical supplied volume for allocation output
no generalization beyond the tested active-River/UserDemand topology
